reason: Frozen PR #755 established a clean three-root dependency-security RED at exact head fddf1f73e9b0ac9f20f6c492b9404b79b094149e / Stage run 32724952061, but fresh production materialization under exact npm@10.9.2 falsified #754's scoped-override re-resolution assumption. requiredBehavior: Provide a repository-specific helper at scripts/dependencies/reconcile-letta-sharp-lock.js; do not introduce general-purpose dependency-resolution infrastructure.
The helper must accept an explicit package-lock path and operate only on lockfileVersion 3 JSON; it must never invoke npm itself.

Before mutation, require @letta-ai/letta-code exact 0.30.5 with declared sharp range ^0.34.5, root node_modules/sharp exact 0.35.3, and nested node_modules/@letta-ai/letta-code/node_modules/sharp exact 0.34.5.

Refuse to mutate if any target stale node has an unexpected version, if root sharp is not exact 0.35.3, if Letta Code is not exact 0.30.5, or if the nested sharp node is already absent/safe.
Write canonical two-space JSON with one trailing LF only after all preconditions pass; expose a pure planning function so tests can prove the exact deletion set without filesystem mutation.

The helper must not write 0.35.3, any resolved URL, integrity, package dependency, override, or final package-lock identity; the subsequent dependency-security successor must still use exact npm@10.9.2 to regenerate and validate final lock bytes.

Tests must prove exact stale fixture deletion, refusal on version drift, refusal on safe/already-reconciled input, preservation of unrelated nested entries, deterministic output, and no mutation before full validation.
